Text:
 TECHNOTE (TROUBLESHOOTING)

PROBLEM(ABSTRACT)
 Is there a limit to the number of items that can be listed within an "in" list as part of a where clause? 

CAUSE
Every time the query optimizer finds a "(NOT) IN" statement in the query, a decision must be made:
Option A: Evaluate the condition sequentially for every member of the IN-list, or 
Option B: create a temporal virtual table from this list and use JOIN logic for evaluation. 

If the amount of members in the IN-list is smaller than the value of INLIST_THRESHOLD, then option A is used. 
If the amount of members in the IN-list is equal or bigger than the value of INLIST_THRESHOLD, then option B is used.


ENVIRONMENT
Any IBM PureData System for Analytics with any NPS Release



RESOLVING THE PROBLEM
The short answer is no limit.


By default we create a virtual table for any "in list" with more than 5 values.

The high CPU usage and hung threads observed during WebSphere Application Server job execution could be due to the WebSphere Application Server attempting to detect and report potentially hung threads using the hung thread detector. This process involves printing messages like WSVR0605W in the SystemOut.log file if a thread runs for more than 10 minutes without completing its task.

To address these issues, you can configure the hung thread detector by setting a custom property. When set, the hung thread detector will automatically generate a javacore or thread dump in the native_stdout.log file whenever a WSVR0605W message is logged, allowing for easier analysis of potential hanging threads.

Title: IBM ITCAM SOA agent (d4) support of TLS - United States

Text:
soa data power DP D4 agent CAMD4ALL TECHNOTE (TROUBLESHOOTING)

PROBLEM(ABSTRACT)
 The SOA D4 Agent was configured for the WebSphere Data Power appliance, which initially used SSLv3. Communication to the Data Power Appliance was changed to TLS, but the SOA agent still attempts to connect using SSL. 

SYMPTOM
The startDC.sh/startDC.bat passes the following Java Parameter during the startup of the SOA DC, 


"-Djava.protocol.handler.pkgs=com.ibm.net.ssl.www.protocol"

This parameter is what causes the SSL communication via the version of JAVA the customer uses when running the startup script.


DIAGNOSING THE PROBLEM
Determine your JAVA version prior to running the startDC.sh/startDC.bat script by running 'java -version'. 


RESOLVING THE PROBLEM
APAR IV66110 (updated with IV68808) implement the POODLE 
(CVE-2014-3566) fix which uses a default TLS rather than SSLv3 protocol.

If you are using a jre not containing IV66110 please see the following 
document, section "Alternative mitigation options" 

http://www-01.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21688165 [http://www-01.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21688165] 

 

PRODUCT ALIAS/SYNONYM
 ITCAM ITCAM4SOA

[http://www.ibm.com/software/websphere/support/lifecycle/] This offering is supported only with WebSphere appliances that are themselves supported. 

NOTE ON LICENSING:
Please Note the "Supporting Program" restriction clause in the license. It means that the IBM Tivoli Composite Application Manager (ITCAM) Agent for WebSphere DataPower Appliance is supplied only for standalone use with WebSphere Appliance Management Center for WebSphere Appliances. The Licensee is prohibited from using ITCAM Agent for WebSphere DataPower Appliance in connection with any other software, this prohibition includes connecting it to an enterprise monitoring infrastructure.  8. Restart the Application Server for the changes to take effect.

Title: IBM How to remove 'Cognos Advanced Workspace' icon from Cognos Connection - United States

Text:
CAW; capabilities; permissions; report studio; icons TECHNOTE (FAQ)

QUESTION
 How to remove the 'Cognos Advanced Workspace' icon from Cognos Connection thus preventing the user from opening reports within Cognos Advanced Workspace. 

ANSWER
- Remove the role/group 'Express Authors' from the user's associated groups. 

Note: This also removes Report Studio Capabilities from that user. If you wish the user to still have Report Studio Capabilities but still not be able to view the 'Cognos Advanced Workspace' icon from Cognos Connection, perform the steps outlined below: 


- Open Cognos Connection.
- Click 'Launch' -> IBM Cognos Administration.
- Select the 'Security' tab.
- Select the 'User Interface Profiles' tab on the left. 
- Click the 'drop down' arrow on the 'Express' selection. 
- Click the Properties button to open up a new window
- Remove 'Express Authors' from the groups and roles.

You should now note when you now log on as that particular user, when you check the user's capabilities they will have the Report Studio Capabilities however they will not be able to view the 'Cognos Advanced Workspace' icon.

Title: IBM Cognos BI control access to Business Insight/Workspace, Business Insight Advanced/Workspace Advanced, and Report Studio - United States

Text:

QUESTION
 In Cognos Business Intelligence, Is it possible to restrict access to Business Insight/Workspace, Business Insight Advanced/Workspace Advanced and Report Studio separately? 

ANSWER
Terminology in different Cognos versions 

10.1 --> Business Insight / Business Insight Advanced 

10.2 --> Workspace / Workspace Advanced 


To give users access to Business Insight/Workspace, open IBM Cognos Configuration -> Security tab -> Capabilities and click the Actions icon followed by Properties for the Executive Dashboard capability. Click the Permissions tab, and grant Execute and Traverse permission to only the user groups/roles who should have Business Insight/Workspace access.

The Host documents state that RDz supports running with Java 6 and 7 on z/OS. While IBM has not officially tested nor supports WPG 6.2 with the use of WMQ version 7.0, we do understand the need and reasons for such. IBM WPG support is planning this testing, however we do not have an estimated time when it will be complete or when the official statement will be released.

Title: IBM Clickjacking through X-Frame-Option Header - United States

Text:
 TECHNOTE (FAQ)

QUESTION
 After a security scan on the Inspector or webreport UI, our scan revealed a vulnerability to Clickjacking by using the X-Frame-Options header. The guidance was along the lines of: "To protect against Clickjacking, it is recommended that any page that contains forms which require a user to enter sensitive information use the X-Frame-Options header set to either DENY or SAMEORIGIN." 

CAUSE
There are three possible values for the X-Frame-Options header:
1. DENY, which prevents any domain from framing the content. The "DENY" setting is recommended unless a specific need has been identified for framing.
2. SAMEORIGIN, which only allows the current site to frame the content.
3. ALLOW-FROM uri, which permits the specified 'uri' to frame this page. (e.g., ALLOW-FROM http://www.example.com [http://www.example.com]) Check Limitations Below this will fail open if the browser does not support it.

Text:

QUESTION
 RDS PRO: Tenable Vuln. Plugin 85582 Web Application Potentially Vulnerable to Clickjacking - Middleware



Security Vulnerability



The remote web server does not set an X-Frame-Options response header or a Content-Security-Policy 'frame-ancestors' response header in all content responses. This could potentially expose the site to a

clickjacking or UI redress attack, in which an attacker can trick a user into clicking an area of the vulnerable page that is different than what the user perceives the page to be. This can result in a user

performing fraudulent or malicious transactions.



X-Frame-Options has been proposed by Microsoft as a way to mitigate clickjacking attacks and is currently supported by all major browser vendors.



Content-Security-Policy (CSP) has been proposed by the W3C Web Application Security Working Group, with increasing support among all major browser vendors, as a way to mitigate clickjacking and other

attacks. The 'frame-ancestors' policy directive restricts which sources can embed the protected resource.

To change the HSQLDB password in NetCool/Impact 6.1.0:

1. Connect to the database using the default ImpactServer name (NCI) and HSQLDB port number (5435).
2. Execute the following SQL command to change the password:
   ```
   SET PASSWORD "new_password";
   ```

3. After executing the command, log out of the database.
4. Edit the HSQLDB DataSource to specify the new password.

Note: Ensure that the new password meets corporate security requirements.
